hero.title: FDM Manufacturing Farm
hero.subtitle: Automated Production Systems for Fused Deposition Modeling

ecosystem.title: Ecosystem Role
ecosystem.desc: This project embodies the **Systemization** phase, removing the founder from the loop. It demonstrates how to scale physical production through software-driven orchestration.

s1.title: 1. Problem
s1.desc: Manual 3D printing farms are not scalable: they require constant supervision, suffer from high downtime during shift changes (night/weekend), and have human error rates (print failures) that erode margins by 15-20%. Labor cost eats the competitive advantage of additive manufacturing.

s2.title: 2. Solution
s2.desc: An intelligent orchestration system that virtualizes the printer fleet. The software manages queues, assigns jobs based on material/printer compatibility, and monitors quality in real-time via computer vision. It transforms a collection of machines into a single autonomous 24/7 production entity.

s3.title: 3. Key Results
s3.i1: Productivity: +400% output compared to manual management (from 176 to 720 units/month).
s3.i2: Costs: Labor cost per unit reduced from €8 to €1.5.
s3.i3: Reliability: Print success rate > 95% thanks to AI detection.
s3.i4: ROI: Payback on infrastructure investment in < 6 months.

s4.title: 4. Business Model
s4.i1: Internal cost optimization for Luna/r (cost competitive advantage).
s4.i2: B2B Service Bureau: Contract manufacturing for small series (100-1000 pcs).
s4.i3: Technical Consulting: 'Farm-in-a-Box' packages for companies wanting to internalize production.

s5.title: 5. Tech & Competitive Advantage
s5.i1: Stack: Python/Klipper backend with proprietary job orchestration.
s5.i2: AI Monitoring: Custom computer vision module for 'spaghetti failure' and bed detachment detection.
s5.i3: Auto-Recovery: Automated reassignment logic for failed jobs on free printers.

s6.title: 6. Current Status & Roadmap
s6.status: Status: Fully operational on a fleet of 15+ machines. Manages 100% of Luna/r production.
s6.i1: Q2 2026: Robotic arm integration for automatic part removal (full lights-out manufacturing).
s6.i2: Q4 2026: SaaS release of the management dashboard for third parties.

s7.title: 7. My Role
s7.i1: Full development of the queue management middleware in Python.
s7.i2: Physical and electrical setup of the farm (ventilation, safety, networking).
s7.i3: Definition of optimized print profiles to reduce waste and time.

s8.title: 8. Sustainability (ESG)
s8.i1: Energy Efficiency: Scheduling algorithms that group thermally similar jobs, reducing consumption by 15%.
s8.i2: Minimum Waste: AI detection stops failed prints immediately, saving kilograms of plastic.
